action.name: Padless HyperBoost FullPower330W to USB-C100W transition
action.value: Confirm paired mode 7 on FullPower330W, observe one fresh UsbCPower100W classification after the operator transition, then restore exact Balanced immediately

validation.applyResult: Applied successfully once from the confirmed Balanced and Automatic baseline on FullPower330W.
validation.readbackResult: Confirmed paired HyperBoost mode 7 and then one fresh UsbCPower100W adapter classification while the pad remained absent.
validation.restorationResult: Restored successfully once to the saved Balanced pair immediately after the adapter query.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: Confirmed exact Balanced restoration and fresh post-restoration pad absence.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: The validator used the dedicated hash-pinned adapter-transition plan and permitted exactly one fresh destination adapter query before restoration.
The initial adapter was FullPower330W. After paired mode-7 confirmation and explicit operator authorization, a fresh typed query returned UsbCPower100W.
Physical pad absence was confirmed before apply, again after the adapter swap and before its query, and after exact Balanced restoration.
The private bounded semantic record binds the exact Capture executable, dedicated transition plan, typed adapter classes, and successful restoration.

limitations: This run validates one immediate FullPower330W to UsbCPower100W transition and exact restoration; it does not establish sustained operation on USB-C power.
No benchmark or dwell was performed during the adapter transition.
The result is scoped to the exact machine, BIOS 4.00, Balanced and Automatic, and confirmed pad absence.
Installed-service low-power and unexpected-exit recovery remain unvalidated, so production padless HyperBoost remains disabled.

productionAdmission.reason: The reviewed adapter-transition gate passed, but installed-service low-power and crash-recovery gates remain independently required.

notes: The OpenBlade service and competing Razer applications remained inactive.
No Razer service was started, stopped, or restored by the validator.
